Chapter 4. The book club and book covers how to choose a book. The first step is to collect suggestions, and every member is allowed to propose up to two titles. After that, the organizer compiles a shortlist of no more than six and circulates it a week before the vote. Voting is by ranked choice, which means each member lists their top three, and the winner is the title with the most points. In the case of a tie, the member who hosted most recently has the casting vote. Members should keep in mind that books over 400 pages need extra time, so the organizer may schedule them for a two-month slot.
